Energy Audit Reimbursements

Application Period is Closed

The Energy Audit Reimbursement Program provides up to $1 million in total funding for Level II ASHRAE energy audits up to a maximum of $20,000 per recipient. The Missouri Department of Natural Resources’ Energy Audit Reimbursement Program uses funding received from the U.S. Department of Energy under the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (ARRA) of 2009. Awards are made on a first-come, first-served application process.

Eligibility

Eligible entities include public K-12 schools, public two- and four-year higher education institutions and local governments (including hospital districts, sewer districts, water supply districts, sub-districts of a zoological park and museum districts and publicly owned municipal, county, regional and international airport facilities). Entities who have utilized the Energy Audit Reimbursement Program in previous cycles are not eligible to apply. 

Application and Supporting Documents

The application period is closed.

  • Missouri Energy Audit Reimbursement Program Application MO 780-3002
  • Missouri Energy Audit Reimbursement Program Scope of Work MO 780-3003
  • Missouri Energy Audit Reimbursement Program Reimbursement Request MO 780-3004
  • Missouri Energy Audit Reimbursement Program Exhibit A - Certifications
  • Missouri Energy Audit Reimbursement Program Exhibit C - General Terms and Conditions
  • Missouri Energy Audit Reimbursement Program Exhibit D - ARRA Special Terms and Conditions
  • Missouri Energy Audit Reimbursement Program Survey

If the applicant provides any “personal information” as defined in section 105.1500, RSMo, concerning an entity exempt from federal income tax under Section 501(c) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, the applicant understands and agrees that it is voluntarily choosing to seek funding and providing such information for that purpose. The state will treat such personal information in accord with section 105.1500, RSMo.

Information and Assistance

Please refer to the Notice of Funding Opportunity for more information.
